biotools.summary: kCSD-python is an open-source Python package for estimating Kernel Current Source Density (kCSD) and related tools for analyzing experimental data and interpreting results. It allows CSD estimation for arbitrary electrode distributions and includes diagnostic aids, demonstrated in a Jupyter Notebook tutorial.
